title: Warzone 2100
description: The open-source 3D real-time strategy game from 1999, officially ported to the browser. Build a base, research technology, design your own tanks from parts and fight through the campaign or a skirmish against the AI.
how_to_play: Choose Play Now under Web Edition. The first run downloads about 60 MB of game data. Start the campaign or a skirmish, build structures and factories, research upgrades and send your units to destroy the enemy base. Played with mouse and keyboard.
